text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Japanese Derby, Tokai 
Teio trained relentlessly for the Kikuka 
Sho――a race said to be won only by the 
strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, pushing herself too far caught up 
to her, resulting in a leg injury, and she 
was informed that running in the Kikuka 
Sho would be nearly impossible in her 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she displays firm resolve, 
insisting she will continue training even 
if it pushes her too hard, in order to run 
in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moved by her passion, the Trainer 
researched and tried various treatments, 
somehow managing to nurse her back to 
health.
